definitions: A piece of something thin, such as cloth, paper, or metal, hinged or attached only on one side.
The motion or sound of something broad and flat moving up and down or to and fro.
A state of agitation, panic, or excitement.
A hinged part of an aircraft wing used to increase lift or drag.
examples: The bird gave a sudden flap of its wings.
Don't get in a flap about the meeting.
The pilot lowered the flaps for landing.
